title: Vickers Wellington LP841 - Stone
memorial_details: Rough cut rectangular stone, possibly limestone, with polished front face and rough hewn edges. Commemoration incised in black, upper and lower-case letters. RAF and RCAF crests in top left and right corners.
inscription: THE SITE AT WHICH/ WELLINGTON/ LP841 OF 82 O.T.U. -/ OSSINGTON CRASHED/ 5TH JANUARY 1945/ WITH THE LOSS OF 4 CREW AND 1 SURVIVOR/ THE NAMES OF THESE MEN ARE DISPLAYED IN/ ST. MICHAEL THE ARCHANGEL CHURCH, LAXTON./ WITH THANKS TO ALL THE YOUNG MEN AND WOMEN/ WHO CAME FROM FOREIGN SHORES/ TO HELP OUR COUNTRY IN A TIME OF NEED/ (maker)
community_connection: With Thanks To All The Young Men And Women Who Came From Foreign Shores To Help Our Country In A Time Of Need
